_about: Plain-language notes for TwinThink's own Twin, one per change, written for visitors. Keyed by short commit hash. Neutral by design: no private project names or mechanics.

branches.surface: how one idea is shown to people
branches.deploy: keeping the site up and reachable
branches.engine: predicting, testing and proving what an idea does
branches.graph: what an object is made of, part by part
branches.rights: who owns an idea, and who may see it
branches.tooling: working with Twins from the terminal and AI assistants
branches.disclosure: deciding what the public sees and what stays private
branches.mark: the name, the logo, the look
branches.canvas: a place where ideas can be found and entered
